full_cycle_projection: exact zero when selected_bin * projection_bars is divisible by return_window; integer roots-of-unity identity, not an epsilon threshold or fitted filter
label: log(close[t+8])-log(close[t]); price forecast label, NOT trading PnL or execution/fee label
sample_policy: UTC two-hour origin grid; reject any missing bar in the64-return feature plus8-return label span; purge fit labels at or after2024-01-01; every audit label strictly before2024-12-15
model: per-symbol/per-selected-bin zero-intercept one-feature slope; beta=(sum(x*y)/sum(x*x))*n/(n+12), fitted ONLY from2022-2023; no parameter grid or optimization
uncertainty: descriptive slope standard-error scale sqrt(sum((y-beta*x)^2)/(n-1)/sum(x*x)); not an iid confidence interval or financial guarantee
feature: unconditional strongest mean-centered64-return harmonic bin2..8, using full time-domain energy; computes features even when old0.40 concentration gate would reject; does not change or rerun the failed old strategy
audit_policy: only pre2024 fit labels reach coefficient fitting; freeze fit coefficients before audit evaluation, never refit on audit labels; indicative hurdle mask abs(beta*x)>0.0024+2*abs(x)*slope_error depends only on frozen fit and current observed feature
